title: Release
description: A Qualified Person certifies a batch fit for release (ICH Q7 / EU GMP Annex 16). This is a claim, not a confirmation - whether the QP is who they claim to be, and how far their accreditation reaches, is answered by their entity trust level (OWM-6), not by this schema (spec Sec.8.1).

certified.description: false is representable and meaningful: a QP declining to certify a batch is itself a statement worth logging.

standard.description: The basis for the decision, e.g. "eu-gmp-annex16".

reference.description: A reference number for the release record, held off-chain.
